To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

high efficient non-fusion prokaryotic coexpression and renaturation were fulfilled for chimeric Fds and light chains of a humanized anti-hepatoma Fab, and the renatured chimeric Fab had high affinity for relative antigen.
the chimeric Fv antibody fragment was successfully produced in E.coli, and the refolding yield of chimeric Fc was up to 59.45%.
we successfully expressed and renatured chimeric Fab, which laid a solid foundation for further research and application of chimeric antibody.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction, expression, refolding and identification of chimeric antibody.
the high efficient prokaryotic production and renaturation for chimeric Fab, which will be of great significance to the research and application of chimeric antibody in the future.
the high efficient expression of non fusion chimeric Fc fragment and chimeric LC in E.coli and the renaturation of the two fragments into chimeric FAb.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the chimeric Fab was efficiently expressed and renatured in E.coli, which laid a solid foundation for its application in the treatment of hepatoma.
the high efficient prokaryotic renaturation of Fab was successfully fulfilled in this experiment, which would be helpful for further research and clinical application.
the chimeric Fc-Fab antibody is successfully expressed in E.coli and the renaturation of Fab fragment from chimeric F(ab)2 is successfully fulfilled by gradient dialysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have established the prokaryotic system for the production of the chimeric antibody against human hepatocellular carcinoma, and we have successfully expressed the chimeric Fab fragment in Escherichia coli.
we have successfully expressed the chimeric Fv fragment and chimeric Fab in E.coli, and have obtained high yield of chimeric Fc fragment and chimered Fab.
we successfully expressed chimeric Fds and chimeric Ls in high efficiency and refolded them into cFab.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the chimeric Fabs could be produced in large quantities by using the prokaryotic system, which could be used for the further research on anti-tumor therapy.
the chimeric Fab can be expressed in E.coli with high yield and can be refolded into active form.

we have developed a novel strategy to produce large amount of chimaeric Fab antibodies against human hepatoma, which will be a promising candidate for the clinical treatment of hepatocarcinoma in the future.
